description: Kubernetes is a platform that encompasses many concepts and areas. In this path, you'll learn how to containerize and deploy a Kubernetes application, manage application lifecycle and configuration, networking considerations, workload options and security, and more. Each course builds upon the next and includes hands-on exercises to reinforce the material covered in each lesson.
summary_ja: コンテナ化からデプロイ、ネットワーク、セキュリティまで学ぶKubeAcademy推奨の総合学習パス
title: Kubernetes Core Concepts

description: Ready to dive a little deeper into the world of Kubernetes? Get up to speed on the first principles of a cloud native infrastructure, then learn how to containerize and deploy a Kubernetes application in our lab environment.
summary_ja: ラボ環境でコンテナ化とKubernetesへのデプロイを実践する対話型入門コース
title: Interactive Introduction to Containers and Kubernetes

description: Understand why we need the concept “packaging” in the Kubernetes world and the problem that tools like Helm address. Learn the basic helm commands to install, upgrade and rollback different charts, how to create the skeleton of a new helm chart, and how to templatize chart YAML files using the go-template language.
summary_ja: Helmの基本コマンドからチャート作成・テンプレート化まで学ぶ実践コース
title: Helm 101

description: Review the curriculum for the CKA exam and the main resources that will help you prepare, and discuss the main tasks you should be prepared to perform: installing and upgrading clusters, backing up and restoring etcd, and more. Also covers aliases, shortcuts and command completion, editing YAML with Vim, kubectl, and other CLIs.
summary_ja: CKA試験のカリキュラム、対策リソース、クラスタ運用タスクを学ぶ試験対策コース
title: How to Prepare for the CKA Exam

description: This course lays out the case for container orchestration and provides an overview of the concepts underlying Kubernetes, the leading container orchestration platform.
summary_ja: コンテナオーケストレーションとKubernetesの基本概念を学ぶ入門コース
title: Kubernetes 101

description: From Kubernetes architecture to quick dives into Kubernetes object types. The Kubernetes in Depth course covers the concepts you'll need to understand how Kubernetes works.
summary_ja: Kubernetesのアーキテクチャとオブジェクト種別を掘り下げて理解するコース
title: Kubernetes in Depth
